CheckTitle: Ensure no root account access key exists
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks that the root user has no active access keys.
Risk: Root access keys grant programmatic, MFA-less, unrestricted access to the whole account; a single leak is a full account compromise.

Recommendation.Text: Delete all root user access keys and use IAM roles or least-privileged IAM users for programmatic access.
